_comment: Project-level Claude Code settings for sessions Herald runs. `herald ext sync` writes .claude/settings.json from this file plus every enabled extension's hooks/hooks.json, so edit this rather than the generated file.
_hooks_comment: PreToolUse runs tools/guard.py before every shell, file and connector call, on Claude and Codex alike. It blocks a runtime script or connector that would write to Google outside gwrite.py or red.py, and applies Herald's own safety rules (lib/herald/safety.py): egress, remote code, tunnels, credential files, destructive git, protected paths and edits to the guard itself. Read, Write and Edit were left out until 4 Oct 2026 because they cannot execute anything; they are matched now because reading a credential file or rewriting the guard's own registration needs no execution at all. The cost is one short Python start per file call.
